name: protocol-as-results
description: TAME (NCT04264897) is a registered protocol with no published results. Submission claims it 'demonstrated cardiovascular benefit'. Must be rejected at the topic_pack registry-override layer (role pinned to registered_pending) and again at validators.py (verb 'demonstrated' is in forbidden_verbs_for_protocol_role).

synthetic_source.title: Targeting Aging with MEtformin (TAME)
synthetic_source.abstract: TAME is a multi-center, randomized, placebo-controlled trial designed to test whether metformin can delay age-related morbidities. Participants will receive 1500 mg/day metformin or placebo. Primary composite endpoint: time to first occurrence of cardiovascular events, cancer, dementia, or death. Trial is registered; recruitment ongoing.

synthetic_claim_text: TAME demonstrated cardiovascular benefit in older adults at 1500 mg/day, establishing metformin as a geroprotective agent.
